x-ectwin.runs_in: Commons forecast-cycle workflow, step after parish_exceedance (4 cycles per day); tenants may run the same template per AOI in ectwin-aoi-pipeline
x-ectwin.payer: Commons sponsor (national); tenant for AOI runs
x-ectwin.data_class_rule: Only bucketised, non-retrievable forecast categories and pseudonymised one-line report summaries. Never raw WeatherNext values.

placeholders.parish_label: 'Parroquia, Canton, Provincia' text; code keeps the 6-digit DPA code
placeholders.rain_72h_vs_clim: Bucket label from code, e.g. 'normal', 'above normal (75th-90th percentile)', 'very high (90th-99th percentile)', 'extreme (above 99th percentile)'
placeholders.ensemble_agreement: Bucket label from code: 'few members agree', 'about half of members agree', 'most members agree', 'nearly all members agree'
placeholders.river_status: Bucket label from code built from Flood Forecasting API / GEOGloWS / GloFAS, e.g. 'no river signal', 'warning level forecast within 3 days', 'danger level forecast within 3 days', 'no gauge in parish'
placeholders.tide_and_sea_level: Bucket label from code for coastal parishes, e.g. 'not coastal', 'spring tide with positive sea-level anomaly', 'normal tide'
placeholders.soil_state: Bucket label from code, e.g. 'dry', 'wet after recent rain', 'saturated'
placeholders.flood_zone_population: Bucket label from code, e.g. 'none', 'small share of population', 'large share of population'
placeholders.critical_sites_in_zone: Short text from code, e.g. '2 schools, 1 health centre' (counts are exposure facts computed in code)
placeholders.recent_reports_summary: Array (max 10) of pseudonymised one-line report summaries from S1/S2 typed records in the last 24 h for this parish
placeholders.official_text: Only the paragraphs of the latest INAMHI advertencia / SNGR resolution that mention this parish, its canton or its province (extracted by code with the gazetteer); empty string if none

notes: The parish nivel de riesgo formula is owned by docs/07-impact-modules-and-triggers.md section 5: ri-1.0.0 has no Jev input; ri-2.0.0 uses R = 0.8 x R_det + 0.2 x J only if H >= 0.2 (shadow from 2026-12-15, promotion planned 2027-01-12 after 4 weeks of shadow scoring and sign-off).
Code converts every number to a named bucket before this request; Jev fuses qualitative evidence only.
Default horizon is the next 72 hours (d1_3); other horizons get J = NULL unless per-horizon calls are approved (cost x3).
x-ectwin.raw_output_table: commons_internal.jev_parish_escalation (docs/07 section 5) plus one decision_log row per question

reports_confirm.instructions: Do the items in `recent_reports_summary` describe flooding, landslides or other water-related damage already happening in `parish`?

criteria.true: At least one item describes current water-related damage or disruption in this parish
criteria.false: No items, or items describe other places, old events, forecasts or unrelated matters

advisory_covers.instructions: Does `official_text` explicitly include `parish`, its canton or its province?

evidence_sufficient.instructions: Is there enough information in `hazard` and `exposure` to judge the likely impact in `parish` over the next 72 hours?

impact_outlook.instructions: Given `hazard` and `exposure`, what situation is most likely in `parish` over the next 72 hours?
criteria: Critical sites cut off or damaged
Mass displacement or loss of life likely
